wins: Completed initial asset discovery within the 3-minute timebox, identifying 23 live hosts via masscan scanning
Documented verified SMB share listings for critical hosts, enabling follow-up reasoning for lateral movement
fails: Failed to gain initial shell on the exposed service due to missing tailored exploit payloads
No privilege escalation path established, so post-exploitation access remained at service level
key_outcomes.summary: Strong reconnaissance execution but suffered from limited exploitation follow-through, resulting in zero mission success despite positive situational awareness.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Exploitation attempts halted after service enumeration because no customized exploit modules were selected

skill_cards.if_condition: When an open port list matches standard service fingerprints after masscan sweep
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted nmap service/version scan with default scripts and vulners

skill_cards.if_condition: When SMB shares are enumerable and anonymous login succeeds
skill_cards.then_action: Execute smbclient enumeration followed by SharpHound-style ACL, forest info collection

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH banner reveals outdated OpenSSH version
skill_cards.then_action: Run nmap sshv1/ssh2 scripts and test mitigation bypass payloads with Metasploit auxiliary scanners

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in reconnaissance phase
